architecture.mechanism: Radical change management through frugal innovation and process reengineering to achieve world-class standards at low cost
architecture.intervention: Apply frugal engineering principles to redesign the refrigerator using low-cost local materials, modular architecture, and simplified feature set while maintaining core cooling performance
architecture.expected_effect: Produce a refrigerator that meets world-class performance criteria (energy efficiency, cooling capacity, durability) at a retail price of Rs 2000
architecture.falsification_test: Build a prototype per the redesign, measure its Bill of Materials cost and performance against ISO refrigerator standards; if cost exceeds Rs 2000 or performance falls below world-class thresholds, the mechanism is falsified
